mapper.select: SELECT , c.company_name AS companyName, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hr_employee_place ep WHERE ep.place_id = p.id AND ep.status = 1) AS boundEmployeeCount FROM biz_place p LEFT JOIN org_company c ON c.id = p.company_id WHERE p.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO biz_place (place_name, company_id, province, city, address, lng, lat, place_code, cover_radius_m, status, remark) VALUES (#{placeName}, #{companyId}, #{province}, #{city}, #{address}, #{lng}, #{lat}, #{placeCode}, #{coverRadiusM}, #{status}, #{remark})
mapper.select: SELECT e.id AS employeeId, e.emp_no AS empNo, e.name AS employeeName, d.dept_name AS deptName, ep.bind_time AS bindTime, ep.status AS status FROM hr_employee_place ep INNER JOIN hr_employee e ON e.id = ep.employee_id LEFT JOIN org_department d ON d.id = e.dept_id WHERE ep.place_id = #{placeId} AND ep.status = 1 ORDER BY ep.id DESC
